description: Upcoming scheduled tennis fixtures, earliest first. This is the forward schedule, filterable by tour. Use this for "what is on this week". Works on the FREE plan (no card needed).

tour.description: Tour filter. Each name covers its doubles variants. Exhibition/team events carry no tour and are excluded whenever the filter is used.

name: get_fixtures

start_time.description: Scheduled start, UTC ISO-8601. Null until the order of play assigns a time.

message.description: Human-readable summary of the result, safe to relay to the user verbatim.

ok.description: True when the request succeeded, including when the answer is an empty list. False for a missing or rejected key, a plan that does not include this data, an unknown id, a rate limit or a network error. The message then says what to do. check_api_status is the exception: it is true whenever the API answered, and reports API key problems in the message.

title: Fixture schedule
